content.comment_body: I'm reviewing the new [product_name] modular units equipped with an analog expansion module. It appears the analog inputs can be set to either 0-10V or 0-20mA, which is a useful feature. Do the base units with analog inputs also support both ranges, or are they limited to only 0-10V? [user_name]
For [product_name] basic modules (12/24V DC), only 0-10V analog inputs are supported (I7-I8).

analysis.insight_summary: A user is evaluating [product_name] hardware, comparing the analog input options of the base module to those of the analog expansion module. The expansion module allows both 0-10V and 0-20mA inputs, while a reply clarifies that the base module only supports 0-10V. This limitation might influence the user's intended application and satisfaction.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates that [product_name] base modules with analog capability will offer both 0-10V and 0-20mA input support, similar to the expansion modules.
